global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth topped with vibrant green scallions. Served in a red-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a bright surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: White table surface with subtle texture, smooth and slightly reflective, bordered by dark wooden edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim and repeating geometric and character patterns, glossy surface.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth, golden-brown, textured with bubbles and oil sheen, cradles green scallions and faint noodles beneath.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, elongated pieces with a fibrous texture and faintly visible grain.
